about: The shared parity corpus: ways of writing the same file that a JavaScript check and its Rust twin must read alike. tools/paddock-dev/tests/it/parity_corpus.rs takes every file of a dual-host check's own control tree (a Check's `control()`), rewrites it by each variant below, runs both hosts on the result and compares their findings. A file the check reads as data (its allow file) is left as it is. A check with a twin is checked by adding one line to the tests (see check_c131.rs).

variants.name: case-fold-letters
